scope: first-party active source, launchers, build manifests and UI; dependencies, build outputs and experiment archives excluded
method: static marker candidates plus documented call-graph review; a token match is not proof of Python execution
python_source_count_basis: historical baseline; not a scan of current Python sources

artifact_build_dependencies.kind: CPython embedding + official IsaacLab/Newton/Warp model construction and capture_save

CPython for complete Newton scene/model and physical kernels/codegen, callbacks/FK/publication and APIC registry; optional MoonBit recipe/manager/solver-forward-context host ordering; C ABI for native operations and serialization; independent builder/constant/collision-sparse fragments do not replace the full SDK backend

python_free_authoring_scope: Scene IR/recipe, rigid-tree builder arrays/FK, CPU/Double constant fragments, 13 G1 entries over 11 functions, 4 collision/sparse entries plus mass gather layout, CUB/conditional APIs and independent single-G1-kernel capture; no complete native model/physics four-graph closure is claimed
further_python_free_scope: Typed model/state/control storage with explicit native upload, six primitive contact pairs, packed-tree LDL/small-block Cholesky, dynamic line search/convergence and rigid reference mass/inverse weights; standalone ports do not complete the native physics closure
model_gpu_scope: Resolved primitive shape/contact typed storage; seven primitive CUDA contact pairs; explicit native MuJoCo CPU/Double collision from existing MJB; mixed compact/tiled-gather/tree sparse factorization baseline; owned multi-kernel native GPU launch/capture. Each has its own supported subset and artifact format; none automatically completes or replaces the Newton/MuJoCo-Warp four-graph backend
cooking_device_scope: Historical cooking/device milestone: host Mesh/BVH, authored schema/equalities, distance GJK and shallow contacts, MathDx tiles and convergence control. Superseded for rigid contacts and sparse/solver bodies by full_native_translation_scope below; runtime validation remains deferred
full_native_translation_scope: Native owned Mesh/BVH/Qhull/SDF/NanoVDB cooking resources, rigid GJK/EPA/manifold plus plane/heightfield contacts, cooperative mixed sparse LDL tails and no-pivot sparse LU, full-rebuild Newton/CG reference iteration and incremental/compact adapters, effective metric/preconditioner helpers, authenticated multi-module pipeline. Full SDK/model physical coefficient generation and deformable collision providers are separate boundaries; no whole-backend closure or numerical equivalence is claimed
passive_source_dependencies: Some numerical reports and charter checks read preserved .py source bytes for SHA provenance; this requires source files, not an interpreter
native_library_dependencies: Native MuJoCo, E1 C++ SDK and optional LibTorch RNG/oracle libraries are separate from CPython; Python-wheel installation paths do not imply interpreter execution
